title: Entries carry a stable identity and sequence
outcome: Every entry leaves the client already carrying an identity that never changes and a sequence saying where it belongs in the set. Nothing depends on them yet; this slice only makes them exist at every layer the entry passes through, so the writes that follow have something to key on.
acceptanceCriteria: The entry document schema stores an explicit identity field and a sequence field; Mongoose's automatic subdocument id stays disabled.
The entity-layer entry type, the response schema and the Redux entry draft all carry both fields.
The identity is generated on the client from the platform's own UUID generator before the optimistic update runs, not after it and not on the server.
The sequence is the entry's position in the set, taken from the value the client already tracks.
Recording a rally and reading the game back returns the entry with the same identity and sequence the client sent.
Write behaviour is otherwise unchanged: an append is still an append and nothing yet reads either field.
